prompts.dark: Use case: compositing / ads-marketing. Asset type: final wide GitHub README banner for the existing Avatodo project. Create a clean premium horizontal banner, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio (1800 by 600 ideal). Input image 1 is the EXISTING approved Avatodo mascot to reuse as the supporting character insert: a full-body seated golden 3D lion with black sunglasses. Preserve its character identity, exact seated pose, golden fur, sculpted mane, friendly face, black sunglasses, paws and curled tail. Do not redesign the lion. Place the fully visible lion on the left third, with comfortable space above its mane and below its paws. The right two-thirds contains a large crisp white bold modern sans-serif title and the concise product description below it, all left aligned. Background: very dark navy/charcoal close to GitHub dark mode, with a subtle restrained soft blue radial glow behind the lion; seamless, elegant, no decorations, no stars or particles, no separate cards, no borders. Type hierarchy: huge title 'Avatodo' occupying most of the right-side width; below it a smaller but clearly readable bright-white sentence 'Your voice-driven agent for to-dos and checklists.'; below that, muted light gray text in two lines: 'Runs locally on iPhone. Powered by Meta models.' then 'With you on Apple Watch.' Exact spelling of title: A-v-a-t-o-d-o. Render only these four text elements, no extra label, logo, emoji, badge or caption. Keep the description visually grouped with the title and all text away from the edges. Give the whole layout generous breathing room. At README display width around 900px all text should remain readable. No device mockups, no UI, no new characters. Deliver only the banner image, not a screenshot of a GitHub page.
